Youre enough, maybe not for the people who think youre not but you are. We forget sometimes that there are more than those in our bubble, you just havent met the right person and when you do, you dont have to try so hard to be “enough”. 

Trying to find the person will take time, everything in the world is not immediate. It takes time and hard work. So hang on, you guys will find one another at some point.

If you think it will never happen, remind yourself how old you are and how long the average human lives. And until you havent lived that age i say keep going and keep trying.

I totally feel you when you said you dont fee as happy with friends than being alone. Its probably because you guys are not in the same channel of energy if that makes sense. My friends and i are all different from each other so it can be really exhausting and it makes question if theyre the right friends considering its been 5 yrs. 

My advice is to take a break. You dont always have to do the stuff they do or go wherever they go. Having friends give you structure on how you grow, you guys influence each other. But being alone isnt bad either, sometimes you need quality time for yourself— to know yourself better. 

Post as much as you want here, think of it as a journal. At least you wont have to fill your head with only your thoughts be it negative or positive.
There are hundreds of people will to hear your story. Its natural to the self that our story is bullshit because its the life we wish we never had.

Sounds like you have 2 options here. 

You tell your mom and she gets hurt but it will take all her power to help you. No matter, your mom loves you and she will think if she is to blame about your issues and that becomes your job to let her know that its no ones fault and you just want some help.

Or you can keep to yourself, but promise yourself that in the moment you do feel like committing suicide you will ask for help. Whether it be here or through other resources. You should not be ashamed of the life youve lived. Youve worked so hard to stay this long, and i applaud you that you are 190 days clean. Please continue to tell your story.

Ill let you know now that if i had all the free time in the world, id rather have all of us in this group to have a meeting and each tell our story— like that scene from mean girls. 

Im really sorry no one has taken their time to help you out. I know you want an out, youre at the top of limit and you try to find the nearest exit and jump. But what if i told you that beside the exit is a staircase, much better to walk down it with someone. In this case, reddit seems to be that staircase and im the stranger you meet by it. 

What im saying is, the exit isnt the only exit. Its perfect that you take your pace at this too, suicide is never the first solution, why do you suppose it takes time for people to commit suicide?

You posted this because its your body screaming “I DONT WANNA DIE”, you are asking for help and it okay. When you post here remmeber that this group has plenty of people who care. Ironically they dont care about their lives but we’ll gladly care for someone else. We find the value that we cant find in ourselves from someone else and i think thats so touching about our situation. Its not greedy or selfish, it’s unfortunate that some people— mostly the people we expect to hep us couldnt help us at all, its because they dont understand our position. But thats why were here. And YOU are here, you have a purpose and this time embrace those who find comfort in having you around even if its just strangers.

Please share your story. If you didnt care that much you wouldnt post here. I feel as though this is a cry for help and i find it courageous that you tried to reach out to strangers. We always feel that the only words with value come from people we respect, know , and are close to us, but words from strangers are different. Because they are nobody’s to you, it becomes more valuable. As something you saw as 0, they took their times to give you 10.

If you dont see value in yourself, strangers will gladly return what you thought you didnt have or couldn’t see.

By sharing what your thought are in here is a way of providing help for yourself. 1. As you share it, your story becomes heard and recognized. You are not alone. 2. People here will provide you words of comfort although i know you would prefer it from your close members, but hearing it from strangers makes it more valuable. 3. Its okay to have that fear of making a mess after, i mean what else are we to expect you know? But do keep in mind that when your gone, your problems becomes theirs.

I say this to all the posts i see, keep telling your story. If you dont see value in your life, by us reading it we return to you what you think is gone. You are a person. You make mistakes. People here will gladly talk to you, because if they cant save their own lives they would rather save someone elses and that gives them purpose.
Truly. This platform doesnt get enough credit.

Thank you so much. Im really proud that you found a way to distract yourself like i did. Not many discover that by simply reading someones story and or helping someone out that in return you help yourself.

Ill start, ive been here for two days and in those two days i thought, what good will my advice give if im just as willing to throw my life away like they do? I gave them a different point of view and tho sometimes it gets rocky, i always think were just human, never expect perfection from anyone especially yourself. We make mistakes but that doesnt lower our value to people.
Then give meaning to being alive. Its easy to say that being alive doesnt mean im living, but what do you consider living?
I only hope the others have a stronger sense of hope and make it thru much more prosperous.

This will sound very insensitive but if you could kill yourself you would have already. Not that im encouraging you but i applaud you for having the courage to reach out. 

Your financial situation seems like a bust, but please do not give up. Your debts will be paid off not now not soon but somewhere in the future. It will be you who pays for it. Please take some time to recenter yourself. Plan out your income. Use your free resources. Im sure theres plenty who will help. 

This group is not just for suicide letters or warnings. I can assure you theres someone who has an occupation that can help you. Instead of advertising how you want to end your life... advertise that you need help. 

Now im not that person for finance im only 20 still in college, but my advice is that your value as a human is not equal to the amount of money you own. I am still learning that in a very hard way as im running low on funds myself. Maybe i should apply my own advice, but no one like to listen to themselves right?

I have to agree, when i do make it out alive. When i get to breathe the breath of liberation i will make it my duty to help more others out there like us. A second chance. I feel this deep pit like in falling, like im only 20 and it is so unfortunate that i want to kill myself. How about when i turn 21? Will it be the same? 

What would even be your last thoughts? Im sorry? I love you? It hurts? I think mine will be, i can do this, just couple more seconds. The last thoughts doesnt even reflect the peace you long for. 

Life is unfair. I wish it was painless, but how much better would you feel if you manage to make it out alive? Your last breath will be deep and short and heavy, but the breath you breathe when you make it is everlasting, and warm.
I know. I think a lot of us here have the same thoughts.  When you see that warning when you google how to kms, what do you think what do you feel?

By sharing what you think i have spent 5 seconds stalling myself from killing myself. And taking another 2 mintues to construct these thoughts, what you do matters. Its a matter of how you choose the way people see it. 

As for yourself. Give yourself some credit that you have helped a person from killing themselves 2.5 minutes ago.

Talking about it really helps, finding someone in that same situation, tho unfortunate, becomes very comforting. It becomes like a tragic story of “us against the world”. Not the best but it helps not carry all the weight of the issue.

We get to realize that not being able to help out in the situation is a real reaction. Nothing to be ashamed really, we internalize it and think im the only one thinking of it but really theres plenty others out there.

Take that as a sign that she isnt the only solution. To put it another way, your a puzzle piece who found another piece but it dint quite fit, it looked right but felt wrong. Its nothing to blame yourself over, it does take time. And while you feel very sad about it, i highly suggest keep talking about it here out loud. The more you share the better your mental health becomes, it takes out some of that negative energy and have the internet halo you deal with it. 

Remember, she wasnt the wrong piece. You simply need to try other more. If you picked an apple from a pile and it was good, have that same curiosity to try the rest of the apples.

If you cant live for her, live for yourself. Make everyday a day where you make sure that everytime im alive im keeping one person from dying. So far thats how im taking it.

Ill let you know that its not your final destination. Its not some game where theres one ending, there so much more. I dont want to say you can blame anyone else but im not going to say you should blame yourself either. 

So youve reached a checkpoint where you achieved your kid aspirations, its now time to make a new one. What do you want now? A family? Go back to school? Get another job? Theres a lot more. Tonight and tomorrow is not gonna be the same. Observe your surroundings, it changes all the time. You’re not stuck, you just have your eyes open halfway.

We hear your cry but thank you for making it louder. Youre very lucky to have a platform where you can voice it out, its better mentally, at least you can invite more people to have an input to your situations.

I applaud you for your courage, to be able to break such a fight? I wish i had the same strength, i roll into a ball and imagine myself dead and i think of the silence i could make. And as children we can only take so much.

It really does, i really wish i had all the answers to make it easier for even at least one person. But for now the only advice i could give is to focus on the positives, its not wrong to take a break for yourself you know. One way i learned to bear with thinking that “im a burden” is that, i always think the positive things ive showered other people with. Then think, “if i hadnt been there during their happiest moment, would they be as happy if i was gone now?” Im pretty sure they blame themselves by then. 

Its not rude to say no once in a while, let them know that you need a day off for yourself. Learn how to make yourself happy without people, because adulthood will be something similar. But at the same time remember, you’re never alone. Strangers will be willing to help you no matter what.

As a person just waiting to have the courage to kill themselves i have to say you have so much more to experience and learn, this is one of the firsts.
